top_stories.title: Phishing-Resistant Isn't Enough; Yubico Takes Aim at Identity-Verification Gap
top_stories.summary: Yubico launched YubiID, a new service that bridges identity verification with credential enrollment and recovery across existing identity platforms to address gaps in phishing-resistant authentication. The announcement also includes a post-quantum YubiKey beta, extending Yubico's hardware security key offerings into quantum-resistant authentication territory.

top_stories.title: mSecure password manager hack prompts password reset warnings
top_stories.summary: mSeven Software suffered a cyberattack that exposed an encrypted customer database for its mSecure password manager product. The company is warning current and former customers to change passwords, reset two-factor authentication, and remove passkeys as a precautionary measure.

top_stories.title: Google Calendar phishing campaign hijacks sessions, bypasses MFA
top_stories.summary: A phishing campaign dubbed Operation CloudFire used Google Calendar invites, trusted redirects, and fake login pages to hijack corporate Google sessions and bypass MFA protections. Material Security tracked the attacks, blocked malicious messages, and assisted in taking down nearly 900 domains used by the threat actors.

top_stories.title: Most consumers aren’t ready to let AI agents shop unsupervised
top_stories.summary: Okta's 2026 Customer Identity Trends Report examines consumer attitudes toward AI agents that make purchases, book services, and access personal information. The report finds only 37% of consumers are ready to delegate unsupervised actions to AI agents, with businesses facing new requirements for verifying agents and managing their permissions.

top_stories.title: Descope Envoy brings AI agent authentication to consumer apps
top_stories.summary: Descope has launched Envoy, a set of capabilities enabling personal AI agents to authenticate into consumer apps via delegated sign-in paths with their own identities, permissions, and approval flows. Launch partners include GoFundMe, You.com, GoodRx, and Composio, and the solution integrates with existing authentication stacks without requiring a full rebuild.

news.title: Vercel rolls out new protection against stolen session cookie attacks
news.summary: Vercel is rolling out Device Bound Session Credentials (DBSC) as a defense mechanism against session cookie theft from information stealer malware. DBSC cryptographically binds session credentials to a specific device, preventing stolen cookies from being used on other machines.

news.title: DreamHost confirms data breach exposed FTP logins and webmail sessions
news.summary: DreamHost suffered a data breach in which attackers accessed its File Manager platform for two months, stealing customers' FTP/SFTP usernames and passwords. The breach also exposed webmail session data, involving credential theft relevant to authentication and access management.

news.title: mSecure Warns Users to Change Passwords, Reset 2FA and Passkeys After Suspicious Activity
news.summary: mSecure password manager developer mSeven Software issued an urgent warning to users on November 3 following detection of suspicious activity linked to the app. Users are being advised to change passwords, reset two-factor authentication, and remove passkeys as precautionary measures.

news.title: AWS DataSync Enhanced mode supports OpenID Connect (OIDC) for Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure
news.summary: AWS DataSync Enhanced mode has added OpenID Connect (OIDC) authentication support for Google Cloud Storage and Microsoft Azure Blob Storage locations. The feature uses AWS IAM roles to obtain short-lived credentials from Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure for cross-cloud data transfer authentication.

news.title: Who will security companies buy next in AI agent identity?
news.summary: A Fortune 500 company discovered over 10,000 previously unknown AI agents during a SailPoint proof of concept engagement, highlighting the growing challenge of AI agent identity governance. The article examines acquisition targets in the AI agent identity security space as vendors like SailPoint expand focus on non-human identity management.

news.title: ServiceNow on-behalf-of token exchange with Bedrock AgentCore Gateway
news.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway can be configured to perform on-behalf-of (OBO) token exchange with Microsoft Entra ID, enabling AI agents to call the ServiceNow REST API while preserving the calling user's identity. The integration involves AgentCore Gateway natively handling the token exchange between the AI agent and downstream services using delegated user credentials.

news.title: Opal’s agent.ID virtual event: Top security leaders on governing Al agents
news.summary: Opal Security will host agent.ID, a free virtual event on November 5, 2026, focused on IAM for AI agents. The event will feature CISOs and identity leaders from companies including Elastic, Instacart, Notion, Databricks, and Knostic discussing how to govern AI agent identities and access.

news.title: Oh, your agents need OAuth2, too
news.summary: Dan Moore, Senior Director of CIAM Strategy and Identity Standards at FusionAuth, discussed adapting OAuth2 protocols for autonomous AI agents at the LDX3 conference by LeadDev. The conversation focused on the security requirement of assigning AI agents their own distinct identities and applying established authorization frameworks to agentic workflows.

news.title: Amazon Quick on desktop now uses your organization's existing Amazon Quick sign-in
news.summary: Amazon Quick has updated its desktop application to use the same organizational sign-in method already configured for the web version, eliminating the need for a separate OIDC application registration in the identity provider. Administrators no longer need to perform additional identity provider configuration steps to support desktop app authentication.

news.title: Okta to Announce Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results on December 1, 2026
news.summary: Okta announced it will release its Q3 fiscal year 2027 financial results on December 1, 2026, after U.S. market close. The announcement covers the quarter ended October 31, 2026.

news.title: Phishing-resistant MFA where it matters most, and finding the privileged identities your role report misses
news.summary: The article covers implementing phishing-resistant MFA and passkeys in Microsoft Entra ID, specifically focused on protecting privileged administrator accounts. It addresses identifying privileged identities that may be missed in standard role reports and prioritizing admin accounts due to the high-impact risk of compromised Global Administrator credentials.

news.title: Okta jumps after-hours following tapped inclusion in the S&P 500
news.summary: Okta has been selected by S&P Dow Jones Indices to join the S&P 500 benchmark index. The announcement caused Okta shares to climb 2.1% in after-hours trading.

news.title: Okta Set to Join S&P 500; Others to Join S&P MidCap 400 and S&P SmallCap 600
news.summary: Okta is set to join the S&P 500 index, moving up from the S&P MidCap 400, effective prior to trading on November 4. This index inclusion reflects Okta's market capitalization growth and raises its profile among institutional investors.
